        if os.path.exists(salt_path):
            with open(salt_path, 'rb') as f:
                return f.read()

            salt = os.urandom(16)
            with open(salt_path, 'wb') as f:
                f.write(salt)

            del data[identifier]
            self._save_database(data)

        if not os.path.exists(self.storage_path):
            return {}

    def _save_database(self, data):
